Subject: FinPay discovery recap & MAP draft

Hi Lisa / Raj —

Thanks again for your time today. Quick recap from our discovery and the things I heard as the critical decision criteria:

- Business need: embed LLM-powered transaction summarization and customer support triage into FinPay merchant portal (reduce handle time, improve accuracy).
- Success metrics: 40% reduction in first-response time, pilot NPS > 8, per-token cost < $0.0015 after batching/quantization.
- Security & compliance: SOC 2 required, data retention policy required (30–90 days depending on PCI scope), potential data residency for EU merchants.
- Timeline: procurement + security review in July, contract signed by end of August to start pilot in September.

Attached is a first-draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP-FinPay-v1.pdf) with proposed milestones, owners, and dates. High-level asks from our side:

1) Confirm the economic buyer and the legal/procurement/security contacts we should include on the MAP (I put Raj + procurement@finpay.com as procurement, and used the security contact you mentioned on the call).
2) Confirm whether pilot scope (10 merchants, transaction volume sample attached in the doc) is OK.
3) Let us know any must-have contractual clauses up front (data residency, indemnity, or PCI scoping).

Proposed next step: procurement sync week of July 12 — can you confirm availability? I can draft a short agenda: procurement timeline, SSO/KMS questions, sample SLA, and commercial anchors.

Attachments: [Attachment: MAP-FinPay-v1.pdf (application/pdf, 135KB)]

Thanks —
Marissa

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap and the MAP draft. A few notes from our side:

- Economic buyer: CFO Daniel Park will own final sign-off on spend > $150k. I added him to the thread (cc'd in my calendar invite).
- Procurement & Legal: Raj (cc) will run procurement. Please include Legal early — procurement will need to loop Legal for standard T&Cs and data clauses.
- Security: Priya (cc) will lead security review. SOC 2 Type II evidence is a hard requirement; we also need an answer on whether Redwood supports customer-managed keys (KMS) and details on data egress/retention.
- Pricing: can you provide a ballpark for a 6-month pilot (expected token volume ~20M tokens)? We need this to build the business case for Daniel.

We can meet Jul 13 at 10:00 AM PT for a procurement + security sync. Please share an updated MAP that includes Daniel (economic buyer), Legal, Procurement (Raj), and Security (Priya). Also attach any standard SOC 2 artefacts or a pointer to where we can download them.

I attached our procurement questionnaire as well — will save time if you can pre-fill the sections you can.

Best,
Lisa

Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: FinPay pricing / playbook notes

Marissa —

Quick internal note while we prep the update:

- Pricing anchors: suggest we present two pilot options — Hosted (managed API) and Dedicated (reserved capacity).
  * Hosted pilot: estimated list price ~$0.002/token; with pilot discount 35% → ~$0.0013/token; expected total for 6 months (20M tokens) ≈ $26k after discount.
  * Dedicated pilot: monthly reserved fee + lower per-token rate; requires a commitment (min 3 months) — good if they want isolation/KMS.
- SLA / legal asks: procurement will push for 99.9% uptime in pilot SLA and some termination flexibility; legal will ask for data processing addendum (DPA) + SOC 2 evidence.

I'll draft a one-page pricing appendix and an updated MAP that calls out owners and the procurement checklist (SOC2, KMS, SSO, IP/usage limits). I can also draft a brief contract playbook we can give to Raj.

-Jordan
Account Executive — Enterprise GTM
